sentences.text: Meterchen is currently recognized as a valid taxon, representing the only known species of its genus. Scientists consider this animal a probable goose.
The type species, M. luti, derives its name from a Mother Goose nursery rhyme describing a bird rising from the mud.

This newly described genus and species was named by Tennyson and colleagues in 2026. The publication appeared in the journal Historical Biology, listing authors such as Elizabeth M. Steell and Pascale Lubbe among others.
Fossils of Meterchen come from the Miocene St Bathans deposits in New Zealand. The type locality is the Bannockburn Formation, indicating the animal lived during the Miocene epoch.
